column1: # The recorded licence review, one row per vendored upstream. `docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md` is the
#   name       what this tree calls it
#   path       where it is vendored, relative to the repository root
#   source     the upstream project URL, written down rather than remembered
#   revision   the exact tag or commit - never a branch - or `unrecorded` (see below)
#   digest     the SHA-256 of the source archive as fetched, or `unrecorded`
#   licence    the ONE term this project takes it under, when the upstream offers several
#   patches    the ordered patch series this tree applies, or `none`, or `adapted` when the files
#              were adapted in place rather than patched
# `unrecorded` IS AN HONEST ANSWER AND NOT AN EXEMPTION. It means the import predates this policy and
# its upstream revision was not captured at the time, so the tree cannot say which revision it holds.
# Writing a plausible digest instead would make the inventory agree with nothing. The gate ACCEPTS
# these and NAMES them on every run, so the gap stays visible until somebody establishes the
# revision; a new import may not use it.
